scope: For every connected smooth compact Kahler n-fold, pseudoeffective zero-volume class and actual reference type, degree-d relative full mass and joint-linear integrability define common auxiliary-independent domains. Bare mixed product currents are continuous under decreasing full-mass sequences with full-mass limits. The bounded-family kernel in the actual span of Kahler complementary powers extends unchanged to the whole common domain, giving a quantified minimum operator-data quotient with raw mass, same-type anchor and theta-gauge invariance. A P1 x P1 example computes its geometric kernel and infinite dimension. Rescaled perturbations converge for decreasing original-background full-mass paths with convergent classes and complementary-power quotient data; a same-class alternating-form path has distinct limits. Original P15.2 is not solved.
author_limitations: No intrinsic geometric d-dimensional carrier is constructed: all output measures have carrier X of dimension n, and W/N is reference data only.
No independently geometric general classification of the operator kernel or universal minimum reference for every possible zero-volume theory is proved.

Perturbation independence retains original-background positivity, decreasing common full-mass inputs and full-mass limits, plus convergent auxiliary classes and full-form quotient data; genuinely perturbed-background potentials are only covered in bounded type with smooth auxiliary convergence and sup error o(epsilon).
Arbitrary unbounded moving potentials, increasing sequences, moving rough factors and variable unbounded weights are not covered.
No numerical-dimension identification or equality of actual-reference leading mass with the leading class-volume coefficient is established.
The optional degree-zero bounded-type rigidity question is unresolved; no P15.1 energy quotient is investigated.
